# moddotplot-rs v0.6.1

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.6.1 is a documentation-correction point release. Runtime and scientific behavior
are unchanged from v0.6.0, which remains preserved as an immutable checkpoint.

## Corrected current contracts

The normative scientific specification and design now distinguish the ordinary
production representation from bounded sparse sets available only through the
non-default Rust `validation` feature. Sparse correction remains absent from the
browser protocol, UI, Wasm surface, ordinary web build, production estimator, and
release accuracy contract.

The completed product sequence now includes v0.6.0, superseded ADRs and historical
tables are labeled unambiguously, and the README lists the BEDPE/CSV and PNG/SVG/PDF
Save As features.

Automated documentation checks now enforce these statements in addition to checking
generated parameters, implementation contracts, and local links.

See the [validation record](v0.6.1/VALIDATION.md) for release qualification.
